ai.title: withTimeout clears timer on all paths
ai.summary: withTimeout now uses try/finally to clearTimeout on both resolve and reject paths. Previous implementation only cleared timer on success, leaking handles on timeout. Affects common/src/util/promise.ts. timeoutId typed as ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined for cross-platform correctness.

eli5.text: When you ask the assistant to do something with a time limit, the system now properly cleans up the timer whether the task finishes on time or runs out of time, so leftover timers from failed or timed-out requests no longer pile up unseen in the background. Previously, only successful completions cleared the timer, leaving the system holding onto timers from every timeout, which could gradually slow things down over a long session. You won't directly notice this unless you were experiencing gradually degraded performance from many timed-out requests, but going forward those stale timers are cleaned up automatically on both success and timeout. This is a behind-the-scenes reliability fix rolling out today across the core assistant experience.
